integrity: The arbitrary-field result and dimension minimality are proved symbolically from the explicit direct-product algebra. Finite-field computations are regression checks only and are not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The result answers only the codimension-only splitness question and proves minimality by total finite dimension. It does not classify all prescribed-codimension ideals or address the other open questions in the source.
title: A minimal three-dimensional counterexample to splitness of codimension-base ideals
